newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices down in directionless Nairobi share market.
newsitem.headline: Prices down in directionless Nairobi share market.

text.p: Share prices were generally down at a the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) that appeared to lack clear direction on Tuesday, brokers said.
The NSE 20-share index fell 0.88 points to stand at 3057.66 while turnover was posted at 58.139 million shillings on 713,924 shares versus 8.426 million shillings on 262,881 share Monday.
"The market trading was dull. Only two big lots dealts on special board helped rise the turnover," a broker said.

A Nairobi bourse official said: "Most share prices came down marginally. But turnover surged boosted mainly by two heavy lots dealt in National Industrial Credit and Kenya Power & Lighting from the three-day special board."
There was overbidding for the Kenya Power & Lighting stock. The offer price was at 106 but rose to 116 on bigger demand.
Kenya Power & Lighting traded 400,000 shares and National Industrial Credit dealt 116,313 shares at 46.50.
Housing Finance Company of Kenya fell 1.0 24, Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 52 from 52.50 and National Bank of Kenya fell to 15.80 from 16.
Express Ltd fell to 79 from 80, Kenya Airways held steady at 10.15 on 49,768 shares while Nation Printers & Publishers rose a shilling to 106.
Bourse officials said foreign investors dealt 1,350 shares of Firestone East Africa Ltd at 24.50 and 25, 2,300 shares of National Industrial Credit at 42 and 42.25.
